verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs describe an agent that traces repo structure, plans and scopes multi-file changes, implements features/fixes end-to-end, runs checks, and produces diffs for review — directly matching plain-language feature/bug requests across multiple files. Community evidence corroborates the product is used daily for this purpose (albeit with complaints about bugginess), without disputing the core multi-file agentic editing capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks showing successful multi-file fixes, and no first-party demo/case study detailing a concrete before/after example.
